title: Umphefumlo Ohluphekileyo woMnayile
intro: Ngexesha loxinzelelo olukhulu, xa umlawuli olawula ilizwe ngenkohlakalo epheleleyo, umntu omnye wakhetha indlela yokholo kunentuthuzelo yobukhosi. Lo mntu wayehlala entliziyweni yamandla kodwa wafumana inyaniso kwisigidimi somprofeti othobekileyo. Uhambo lwabo lwaluza kuba sisifundo esingapheliyo somonde, ukuzincama, kunye nokuqiniseka okungagungqiyo. Ungamchonga lo mntu umangalisayo owayekhetha ulonwabo lukaThixo kunesikhundla sehlabathi?
clues: Bendihlala kwibhotwe elinamandla amakhulu, kodwa intliziyo yam yafumana inyaniso kwisigidimi esithobekileyo.
Ndikhethe ukulandela ulwalathiso lukaMusa, ndisazi iziphumo endiya kujongana nazo.
Ndanditshate noyena mlawuli unamandla kakhulu wexesha lam, kodwa ndabalahla oothixo bakhe bobuxoki.
Ukubandezeleka kwam kwakunzima, njengoko ndandisohlwaywa ngenxa yokukholelwa kwam kuThixo omnye.
Andizange ndigungqe elukholweni lwam, nangona ndijamelene nentlungu eqatha.
INkosi yam yaneliseke kukunyamezela kwam yaza yandikhethela indawo ehloniphekileyo eParadesi.
arabic: وَضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ فِرْعَوْنَ إِذْ قَالَتْ رَبِّ ٱبْنِ لِى عِندَكَ بَيْتًۭا فِى ٱلْجَنَّةِ وَنَجِّنِى مِن فِرْعَوْنَ وَعَمَلِهِۦ وَنَجِّنِى مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verse: And Allāh presents an example of those who believed: the wife of Pharaoh, when she said, "My Lord, build for me near You a house in Paradise and save me from Pharaoh and his deeds and save me from the wrongdoing people." (66:11)
